gen-gf-kelly-slab-author: Author reads refined and dignified, with a slight swell in its bowls that gives each word some polish. Kelly Slab's bold display letters are the strongest thing here.
gen-gf-kelly-slab-gf-bhutuka-expanded-on: BhuTuka Expanded One reads slowly, a serif with curvy, unclamped letters and joins as thick as its stems. Under Kelly Slab's bold, wide-eyed display letters, that leisurely walk becomes the pair's strongest quality.
gen-gf-kelly-slab-gf-kiwi-maru: Chunky and confident up top, Kelly Slab hands off to Kiwi Maru, a text serif with generously spaced letters and round, constant-walled o shapes. That pipe-cleaner uniformity is the hook.
gen-gf-kelly-slab-gf-padyakke-expanded-o: Big, bold, and wide-eyed: that's Kelly Slab up top. Padyakke Expanded One answers with round, unmodulated outlines and letters strung out like knots on a slack rope, which is the real draw.
gen-gf-klee-one-archivo: Klee One brings graceful, pen-and-paper handwriting with terminals cut short of the bowl, and its curves are as thick as its stems. And Archivo, a sans-serif with a commanding x-height, gives it a sturdy, outward-opening companion.
gen-gf-klee-one-fs-asap: Klee One writes like a friendly hand, drawn at one weight throughout. Asap, a plain sans, counters with a body height nearly matching its capitals, so the heading handles personality while Asap handles clarity.
gen-gf-klee-one-fs-epilogue: Epilogue is a wire-like sans with stubby ascender tips. Beneath it, Klee One's graceful, casual handwriting adds a gentler note, since its lowercase sits shorter and its terminals stop well short of the bowl.
gen-gf-klee-one-fs-erode: Terminals that stop well short of the bowl give Klee One its casual, pen-and-paper charm. Erode, a text serif, handles the dignified side, with a tall middle band and a gentle ebb and flow of stroke weight.
gen-gf-klee-one-fs-fira-sans: Handwritten charm meets a workhorse: Klee One's casual, thick-only outline sits over Fira Sans, a plain sans with a larger-than-usual x-height. That height gap is what stands out.
gen-gf-klee-one-fs-supreme: Loose handwriting over crisp type: Klee One's short-cut terminals feel graceful and friendly. Supreme, a sans, does the sturdier work, with a heavy-looking strip of text and letters held open instead of curled shut.
